subject.title: fix(gateway): bound BOOT.md file read size

question: Should a BOOT.md larger than 16 MiB fail the boot task visibly or be skipped as empty?
rationale: Both outcomes prevent unbounded allocation, but only failure tells operators that configured startup instructions did not run; current docs and shipped behavior do not define overflow semantics.

options.title: Fail visibly on overflow
options.body: Return a failed boot result with a clear size-limit reason so operators can correct the file while retaining startup-task observability.

options.title: Skip oversized BOOT.md
options.body: Continue gateway startup without executing the file, explicitly accepting silent omission as the product contract.

recommendation.title: Fail visibly on overflow
recommendation.body: Return a failed boot result with a clear size-limit reason so operators can correct the file while retaining startup-task observability.
